chunks: Which is bound to happen undoubtedly --

key_terms.وَقْعَتِهَا: its occurrence / its striking (referring to the Day of Judgment)

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'laisa liwaq'atiha kadhibah' mean in the Quran?
ai.summary: This phrase, derived from Surah Al-Qari'ah (101:1), serves as the opening declaration of the Surah, emphasizing the absolute certainty of the Day of Judgment in Shia exegesis as a time when all falsehoods will be exposed. It underscores the theological concept of *Haqq* (truth/reality), affirming that the resurrection is not a myth but an inevitable reality that will silence all deniers. This opening sets the tone for the subsequent verses describing the weighing of deeds, highlighting the transition from worldly uncertainty to divine clarity.
